title: Exempt byte-identical check scripts from biome formatter
rationale: The fleet standard requires scripts/check-all.ts and scripts/check-ci-parity.ts to stay byte-identical to templates/l5-toolkit, but they are not format-clean under the shared biome config (lineWidth 100); per-repo variation belongs in config, never in the canonical scripts.

name: ci-parity escape hatches via scripts/ci-parity-config.json
description: CI<->check:all parity escape hatches live in scripts/ci-parity-config.json: alias test:ci -> check:coverage (same suite, junit+lcov reporters for artifacts) and ciOnly report:test-timing/report:quality-metrics (always()-run summary emitters). ci.yml runs 'bun run check:all' as the single gate step; separate lint/typecheck/coverage steps were removed as redundant.
